description:
Ragic plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to your Ragic databases, including comments and email threads tied to any record. Once connected, ChatGPT can analyze trends, flag what needs follow-up, and help you think through next steps using your real business data.

Ragic is a no-code AI platform for building custom database systems — CRM, inventory, project tracking, and more.

defaultPrompt: From my Sales Order, tell me my top 5 customers by revenue this month (Sales Order Management)
Which Accounts haven’t had any interaction in the past month? (CRM)
Which items in Inventory are running low on stock? (Inventory Management)
